blocks.body: As the founder and director of the World Changers Summits, I extend my sincerest welcome to you. It is with great pleasure that I introduce this esteemed gathering, a place of boundless inspiration for visionary minds, a profound journey towards expanded consciousness. Celebrated at the Pontifical Academy of Science in the Vatican City, this international summit, has evolved into a global network uniting institutions, brilliant intellects, scientists, entrepreneurs, and experts, all dedicated to the advancement of ethical and social innovation, fostering values and economic progress for the betterment of our world. The World Changers Summits encompass a diverse array of forums, each delving into distinct subjects, serving not only as platforms for knowledge exchange and consciousness expansion but also as gateways to transcend boundaries. A testament to collaborative effort and creative synergy, these exclusive VIP summits, meticulously curated and unique in focus, gather some of the most forward-thinking minds from various fields, converging in different locations and forums. Beyond being a mere academic gathering, this event symbolizes a celebration of collective intellect—a harmonious blend of scholarly pursuits and human empathy. We cordially invite you to do more than observe; become an active participant in this transformative symphony of change. With warm regards,

blocks.html:
The World Changer Summit is a premier platform dedicated to fostering transformative collaboration and innovation. We bring together leaders from diverse sectors—including government, business, academia, and civil society—to tackle the world’s most pressing challenges with a spirit of unity and shared purpose.

In an era defined by unprecedented complexity and rapid change, the World Changer Summit provides a neutral and inclusive space for impactful dialogue and collective action. As a not-for-profit initiative, we are committed to operating independently and impartially, free from any special interests. Our dedication to the highest standards of governance and integrity ensures that our efforts are guided by principles of fairness, transparency, and the power of human intellectual.

Central to our mission is the belief in the extraordinary potential of human creativity, entrepreneurship, and collaboration. We are dedicated to creating an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and where meaningful conversations can drive ethical and innovative solutions. By uniting stakeholders with a shared vision for progress, we aim to catalyse initiatives that address global and regional challenges.

Our commitment to systemic change is reflected in our focus on fostering partnerships and driving initiatives across key areas of impact. Through strategic collaborations and targeted actions, we work to translate ambitious goals into tangible outcomes, supported by a community of committed and forward-thinking individuals and organizations. Together, we strive to create a world where cooperation, mutual respect, and ethical practices pave the way for enduring progress and positive change. By leveraging our collective expertise and resources, we are dedicated to advancing a future characterized by social equity, global harmony, and innovative progress.

The World Changer Summit, founded by Sir Professor Gabriele Pao-Pei Andreoli, began with a vision to unite brilliant minds and innovative spirits in a quest for transformative change. Established with the aim of fostering ethical and social innovation, our summit has evolved into a premier global gathering that bridges diverse fields of expertise and thought.

In its initial phase, the World Changer Summit was launched to create a platform for visionary leaders, scientists, entrepreneurs, and experts to come together. The first event took place at the Pontifical Academy of Sciences in Vatican City. The summit was conceived as a place of boundless inspiration and profound exploration. Our mission was to advance values and economic progress, providing a space where expansive consciousness and collective intellect could thrive.

As the summit grew, it developed into a global network of institutions and thought leaders dedicated to addressing the world’s most pressing challenges. The World Changer Summit became known for its diverse array of forums, each meticulously curated to explore distinct subjects and foster impactful dialogue. These exclusive events are not only platforms for knowledge exchange but also gateways to transcending boundaries and forging new pathways for progress.

In subsequent phases, the summit expanded its reach and influence by creating a series of VIP gatherings that showcase creative synergy and collaborative effort. These gatherings are celebrated as a harmonious blend of scholarly pursuits and human empathy, uniting forward-thinking minds from various disciplines.

Today, the World Changer Summit continues to evolve, reflecting our commitment to ethical practices and innovative solutions. We have established ourselves as a key facilitator of global dialogue and collaboration, where diverse perspectives are valued and meaningful conversations drive systemic change. Our gatherings are more than academic events; they are transformative experiences that celebrate collective intellect and encourage active participation in shaping a better world. Looking ahead, the World Changer Summit remains dedicated to expanding its global network and deepening its impact. Our goal is to create a future where cooperation, respect, and ethical practices lead to enduring progress and positive change.

Why Donate?

items: Empowering Change: Your contribution directly supports the World Changer Summit, providing essential resources and opportunities for individuals and organizations dedicated to creating innovative solutions and addressing pressing global challenges.

Joining a Global Movement: When you donate to the World Changer Summit, you become part of a global movement striving for transformative change. Together, we can achieve extraordinary outcomes and inspire action on a global scale.

It is imperative that we, as a society, reclaim our ethical values and reinstate the importance of public service. Furthermore, we must confront the challenges of financial policy and monetary control. Our collective efforts must be directed towards providing tangible solutions to global predicaments. Held on the month of November 2024 at the Pontifical Academy of Sciences in Vatican City “The world Changers Economic Summit” will be on “The Digital Future of the world and the possible role of the Vatican State” focusing on the latest trends, challenges, and opportunities in the Digital Industry with a focus on Blockchain Technologies and its various applications. As usual a maximum of 21 (top in the field) speakers will be selected. Under the guidance of the Institute for Advance Studies and Cooperation the Summit will produce a report a document of vision and knowledge. The event is intended to be small and very focused. It will be globally announced and live streamed to the world. His Holiness, and a number of key members of the Vatican administration are expected to participate.

Welcome to an elite, invitation-only assembly of top-tier professionals and pioneering companies. This is our crucible, where tomorrow’s visions take form and we discover solutions that promote global well-being. Our discussions intertwine ethics, technology, pioneering research, risk management, security, and the profound implications of artificial intelligence in medicine. At the heart of our dialogue is Evolutionary Biohacking. This holistic approach taps into an array of techniques—spanning medical, nutritional, biological, electronic, and even cosmetic—to elevate our body’s potential, sharpen our minds, and enhance the quality of life we lead.

WCPWS World Changers Power Women’s Summit—an intimate gathering that champions both intellectual rigor and heartfelt connection. Our summit is meticulously curated, bringing together some of the most forward-thinking minds from the diverse terrains of law, the expansive realms of academia, the impactful world of the non-profit sector, and the ever-evolving spheres of politics, among others. Each speaker, distinguished in their domain, has a concise 10 minutes to share insights. More than just an academic conclave, this event is a celebration of collaborative thought. It’s where scholarship meets humanity, where ideas are both profound and profoundly personal. We invite you to be more than a spectator—be an active voice in this symphony of change. Participation is strictly by invitation

Emotions Revealed

The Institute of Advanced Studies and Cooperation, in partnership with the MonteCrypto Club, proudly presents the concept “Emotions Revealed: The Making of the World Changers Power Women’s Summit.” More than just a photographic book, it will stand as a testament to leadership, innovation, unity, and legacy. Throughout the creation of the Summit, we recognized the risk of losing the magical moments shared with our esteemed guests. While the event was an overwhelming spiritual, media, and constructive triumph, we believed many intricate details might fade with time. Our aim was to immortalize these fleeting moments: from our guests’ inspiration and shared wisdom to their awe at the Sistine Chapel, the Vatican Gardens, the Vatican Museums, and the Academy of Pontifical Sciences. “Emotions Revealed” is our response: a large-format, handcrafted photographic book.

The book will showcase the distinct styles from five photographers, with sections dedicated to their unique perspectives. These segments will capture key moments of the WCPWS: from the “white tie” award celebration at the Apostolic Chancery Palace to the private tour of the Vatican Museums, the breakfast in the Vatican Garden, and the summit at the Pontifical Academy of Science.

Walter Leonardi was born in San Cataldo in 1945. From 1986 onwards he was the official photographer of the famous Norwegian anthropologist and explorer Thor Heyerdhal, the Kon-Tiki man. Following him he made important reportages on Easter Island, the Marquesas Islands, the archaeological and anthropological mysteries of Peru, Chile, Colombia, and the pyramids of Tenerife. Eclectic professional and tirelessly curious man, he has signed services ranging from the settlements of Italian gypsies to the operating table of the famous heart surgeon De Bakey, from the illegal migration of the Kurds to the caged prostitutes of Falkland road in Bombay to the gangs of Los Angeles; over time, with his lens, he has portrayed many protagonists of the cinema of yesterday and today: Visconti, Mastroianni, Sordi, Robert Mitchum, Mickey Rourke, John Ford, Oliver Stone, just to name a few. Some of his shots, such as that of Gorbachev’s dacha in Crimea in 1991, have been around the world. Between 1990 and 1991 he made the scoops on Soviet and Russian astronauts in Star City documenting training in the use of the Soyuz shuttles and the Mir Orbiting Station. The first and only Western photographer allowed to film the activities of “supermen” destined for space missions. He has published in over 400 magazines worldwide, including National Geographic, Life, Newsweek…

Roland Tasho, an Albanian photographer, is celebrated for his captures of the 90s December protests and his focus on Albanian communities beyond borders. Since 2001, Tasho has produced 14 photo albums and has showcased his work in exhibitions globally. Notably, he earned the Soros prize in photography in 2000 and received recognition from Hungarian President Ader Janos in 2016.

Anton Giulio Onofri was born in Rome in 1959. Writer and director, with the start of the new century he decided to make independent artistic videos and documentary films about music, art and literature. He works with the magazines Close-Up and Artslife, for which he writes about cinema, music and miscellaneous current events. During Manifesta 12 he exhibited a series of photographs, In ascolto (Magneti Cowork, Parlermo, 2018). In 2019 he took part, with his photographs, in the exhibition Ritratto di famiglia (Roma, Galleria Nazionale). In 2020 he created for Galleria Nazionale Roma città chiusa, a photographic account of Rome deserted during the Covid-19 quarantine. The architecture magazine Panteon entrusted him with the entire photographic apparatus of the issue dedicated to the depiction of Roman places in Pasolini’s books and movies. In December, he opened the exhibition Non mi troverai at the Fondazione Pastificio Cerere in Rome, a photographic project about his friendship with the artist Gian Maria Tosatti. In February 2023, the exhibition is on display at the Fondazione Mudima in Milan.

Bruno Sbrighi is an Italian photographer who has built his career on film and television sets portraying the great actors and characters of cinema. His beginnings in fashion in Paris saw him collaborate with the great designers and with magazines such as “Elle”. After moving to Berlin, he finally arrived in Italy in the seventies where he dedicated himself to his true passion; film sets. Over the years he has collaborated with more than eighty film productions creating several hundred portraits with European film stars and directors, expertly telling with his photographs the work behind the quite of set designers, costume designers, producers, writers. From his ingenuity and vision have sprung several books and photographic exhibitions through which one can understand the evolution of cinema and its languages and techniques.

Sélène de Condat a French artist who lives between Paris, Rome and Palermo. Her photographic work is rooted in day-to-day work, in the expertise and the ancestral knowledge of the professions. Interested in all the aspects of the life of workers, she devoted two large exhibitions to Paris’s sewage workers. Heroine of contemporaneity, the photographer boasts two catalogs to praise, both on forgotten works, the last of which, “Les artisans de la propreté” collects shots on black and white of garbage collectors, dark and shiny, currently on display in the City of Light, just inaugurated in the presence of the mayor Anne Hidalgo. She has been regarded in major magazine and exhibitions as her photographic work draws inspiration from ancient crafts and places the human being at the center of plastic and philosophical reflection. Her style is characterized by chiaroscuro.

The Print

  • “Emotions Revealed” will be featured in a large-format, handcrafted photographic book, printed on specialized paper using select inks.
  • Out of the 30 numbered “Emotions Revealed” volumes, the first copy will be donated to the Holy Father.
  • Additionally, 200 numbered copies in a 12 by 12 format are available for pre-order at emotions@iascoop.org.
  • This project is non-profit, and all proceeds will go towards humanitarian causes. Your support is deeply appreciated.

Apostolic Chancery Palace, was the first palazzo in Rome to be erected from the ground up in the new Renaissance style. According to Vasari the works were partly executed by Bramante. In the Palazzo is a vast mural that Giorgio Vasari completed in a mere 100 days, therefore named the Sala dei Cento Giorni. He boasted of this accomplishment to Michelangelo, who responded “Si vede” (“It shows”). And it is in this historical unique mesmerizing “sala dei cento Giorni” that the “World Changers Power Women’s Summit” has the exclusive honor to invite its prestigious guest on October the 12th 2023 to a formal award ceremony event and award ceremony.
